checkpoints.name: cactus_sdd_gap_lower_bound
checkpoints.description: Theorem 8 with Corollary 2 of Kalantarzadeh-Kumar (APPROX 2025, arXiv 2507.06576v3): if the cactus family is SDD(2w, p)-acceptable for even w >= 2 and 0 < p < 1, then 8/7 <= w*p. Via the paper's Theorem 2 (not formalized), this is the 16/7 multiflow-multicut gap lower bound for cactus, hence planar, graphs.
